issues.reason: The exposure half stands — the compound rule's predication test ('can the modifier be predicated of the thing?') fails for the bound prefix 'mini-', and exposure is licensed only for a gradable, positional/cardinal or material *adjective*, so `(Inheritance mini_lift mini)` is unlicensed — but the 'should not fuse at all' half falls: 'mini-lift' is a hyphenated lexical compound, not the incidental adjective+noun description of 'a dented pail', so the symbol `mini_lift` and its genus `(Inheritance mini_lift lift)` are correct.

gaps_confirmed: the implicit subject of a purpose infinitive ('devised a mini-lift to allow …') — the purpose-infinitive rule fixes the connective head and clause order but not who fills the purpose event's subject role
the object of 'get on / off NP' — whether a particle verb whose particle is also a preposition takes a thematic role (phrasal-verb rule) or the preposition-named oblique (prepositional-verb rule)
new_gaps: a hyphenated bound-prefix compound ('mini-lift', and likewise micro-/mega-/pseudo-): the compound-kind rule assumes a free-standing modifier word and its two branches (expose iff adjectival / never fuse incidental size) give no reading for a prefix that is neither a noun modifier nor a predicable adjective

'allow X to V' as a control/permission verb: the control-verb pattern names try/want/decide/…, so whether the permitted event attaches by `Theme` with the object controller copied in as its `Agent` is an extension, not a stated rule
repair_summary: Removed `(Inheritance mini_lift mini)`, the unlicensed exposure of a bound size prefix as a property genus.
notes: Everything else is left as parsed: `get_on` / `get_off` kept whole with no genus, `(To sk_devise_1 sk_allow_1)` with no tense on the non-finite chain, and the two boarding events coordinated as two `Theme` atoms on one allow event.
